jobs.title: R&D Software Engineer
jobs.description: Please Note: 1. If you are a first time user, please create your candidate login account before you apply for a job. (Click Sign In > Create Account) 2. If you already have a Candidate Account, please Sign-In before you apply. Job Description: Position Overview We are seeking a Staff/Principal R&D Software Engineer (ICB5) to serve as a technical architect and hands-on leader in redefining how enterprise software is built, orchestrated, and delivered using Agentic AI . In this individual contributor leadership role, you will design, build, and deploy high-impact AI systems and platforms that unify Product Portfolio Management (PPM/SPM), Agile Planning, Engineering Execution, and DevOps into an autonomous operating engine. Working at the intersection of AI/ML, distributed systems, and software engineering productivity, you will partner closely with Engineering, Product, and R&D Leadership to architect scalable Agentic AI workflows, modernize technical delivery platforms, and optimize the ValueOps portfolio. The ideal candidate combines deep software engineering expertise in distributed systems and AI platform development with a systems-thinking approach to software delivery pipelines, Lean Portfolio Management, and developer productivity. What You'll Do Architect & Build AI-Powered Delivery Platforms Design, build, and scale Agentic AI systems, LLM pipelines, and autonomous agents integrated directly into R&D, product management, and engineering workflows. Engine-level development for AI-driven business case generation, automated backlog grooming, capacity modeling, and predictive portfolio risk analysis. Transform manual project and product management processes into event-driven, autonomous software workflows using modern agentic frameworks. R&D & Engineering Productivity Transformation Partner with Platform Engineering, DevOps, and Security teams to embed AI copilot patterns, CI/CD telemetry, and Value Stream Management engines into standard developer workflows. Architect real-time operational telemetry engines and executive dashboards by aggregating data from across modern developer toolchains (e.g., git, CI/CD pipelines, issue trackers, deployment platforms). Eliminate friction in software execution through intelligent automation, automated static/dynamic analysis integration, and self-healing deployment pipelines. Technical Leadership & Governance Function as the principal technical authority across cross-functional R&D initiatives, leading technical designs, RFCs, and architecture reviews. Manage complex technical dependencies, system interfaces, and API contracts across core product, cloud infrastructure, and security platforms. Define and maintain technical benchmarks for system reliability, latency, cost-efficiency, and privacy for deployed Agentic AI models. Change Engineering & Culture Drive technical adoption of AI engineering practices across global R&D teams. Mentor senior and staff engineers in agentic architectures, prompt/context engineering, graph databases, and resilient system design. Champion a culture of high engineering standards, continuous integration, data-driven decision-making, and open technical discourse. Qualifications Required Experience : Bachelors and 12+ years of related experience; at this level a post-graduate degree is typically expected or Masters degree and 10+ years of related experience or PhD and 7+ years of related experience 10+ years of professional software engineering experience building complex, distributed backend systems, enterprise platforms, or developer tools. 3+ years in a technical leadership capacity (Staff/Principal Engineer or equivalent IC level) driving cross-organization architecture initiatives. Strong proficiency in modern enterprise programming languages (e.g., Python, Go, Java, TypeScript/Node.js). Hands-on experience developing, fine-tuning, or deploying Generative AI, Agentic AI, or LLM-based architectures (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel, custom multi-agent orchestrations). Deep technical understanding of Software Portfolio Management (SPM), Agile delivery engines, and DevOps toolchains (e.g., Jira APIs, GitHub/GitLab, Azure DevOps, Jenkins/GitHub Actions). Proven track record of architecting event-driven systems, RESTful/gRPC APIs, and scalable data pipelines. Exceptional technical communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex architectural decisions to both technical peers and executive leadership. Preferred Strong understanding of ValueOps concepts: Lean Portfolio Management, Value Stream Management (VSM), OKR tracking systems, and financial capacity modeling. Experience with graph databases (e.g., Neo4j), vector stores (e.g., Pinecone, Milvus, Qdrant), and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pattern optimization. Background in cloud-native platform engineering (Kubernetes, AWS/GCP/Azure serverless architectures, Terraform). Experience building or customizing software planning tools (Clarity, Rally, ServiceNow SPM, Planview). B.S., M.S., or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related quantitative field. Leadership Competencies Architectural Visionary: Able to translate high-level business goals into clean, resilient, and extensible software architectures. Engineering Force Multiplier: Elevates the technical capability of surrounding engineering teams through code reviews, design docs, and hands-on implementation. Data-Driven & Systems Minded: Analyzes engineering metrics (lead time, deployment frequency, MTTR) to systematically identify and automate away execution bottlenecks. Pragmatic Innovator: Balances cutting-edge AI experimentation with enterprise-grade stability, security, and scalability requirements. Success Measures Within the first 12 months, this technical leader will: Architect & Deploy Agentic Workflows: Deliver production-ready Agentic AI modules that automate key planning, tracking, and prioritization tasks across R&D teams. Standardize AI Engine Integration: Establish a reusable technical framework and API layer for embedding AI agents into existing ValueOps and developer toolchains. Drive Productivity Metrics: Achieve a measurable improvement in R&D velocity, lead time, and planning overhead through automated intelligence and system integration. Elevate Technical Capability: Author key architecture blueprints and mentor R&D teams on best practices for building scalable, reliable AI-driven enterprise applications. Compensation and Benefits The annual base salary range for this position is USD 143,800.00 To USD 230,000.00 As a valued member of our team, you'll be eligible for a discretionary annual bonus and the opportunity to receive not only a competitive new hire equity grant, but also annual equity awards, connecting your success directly to the company's growth. All subject to relevant plan documents and award agreements. Broadcom offers a competitive and comprehensive benefits package: Medical, dental and vision plans, 401(K) participation including company matching, Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP), Employee Assistance Program (EAP), company paid holidays, paid sick leave and vacation time. The company follows all applicable laws for Paid Family Leave and other leaves of absence. Broadcom is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We will consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship, disability status, medical condition, pregnancy, protected veteran status or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. We will also consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records consistent with local law. If you are located outside USA, please be sure to fill out a home address as this will be used for future correspondence.

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, Amazon Music, Partner Payments & Reporting
jobs.description: Amazon Music is an immersive audio entertainment service that deepens connections between fans, artists, and creators. From personalized music playlists to exclusive podcasts, concert livestreams to artist merch, Amazon Music is innovating at some of the most exciting intersections of music and culture. We offer experiences that serve all listeners with our different tiers of service: Prime members get access to all the music in shuffle mode, and top ad-free podcasts, included with their membership; customers can upgrade to Amazon Music Unlimited for unlimited, on-demand access to 100 million songs, including millions in HD, Ultra HD, and spatial audio; and anyone can listen for free by downloading the Amazon Music app or via Alexa-enabled devices. Join our team for the opportunity to influence how Amazon Music engages fans, artists, and creators on a global scale. Learn more at https://www.amazon.com/music. Amazon Music's Partner Payments and Reporting team serves as the critical bridge between every listener and content partner, building end-to-end platforms that process every play activity and deliver accurate, on-time payments to music partners worldwide. These teams gather data from multiple internal sources, enrich it through sophisticated data pipelines, and deliver external reports while processing royalties at unprecedented scale using distributed systems and big data technologies. The teams are building multiple products from scratch to support Amazon Music's continued growth, focusing on platforms that scale with business demands while solving some of the hardest technical problems in music licensing, vendor royalties, and partner data delivery. Key job responsibilities As a Software Development Engineer on the Partner Payments and Reporting teams, you will design and build scalable backend services that process streaming data at massive scale, handling payment calculations and royalty distributions for music partners across multiple countries. You will develop and maintain data pipelines that gather, enrich, and transform data from multiple internal systems to generate accurate external datasets and reports for content partners. You will build end-to-end reporting platforms including critical data validations, data lakes, delivery systems, and audit mechanisms to ensure payment accuracy and completeness. You will be solving distributed system challenges involving big data processing, working at the limits of scale to handle billions of play activities and financial transactions. You will collaborate across multiple teams including technology, business, and operational stakeholders to deliver projects that support music licensing requirements, and contribute to platform innovation by building new systems from the ground up that anticipate future music licensing demands and enable continued business agility, using Gen AI technologies. You will do this while ensuring data quality and reliability as the last line of defense between Amazon and external music partners, maintaining the trust of labels, publishers, and collection societies worldwide About the team Come join a team that's building next generation business and financial automation tools to support licensing and payment business obligations, leveraging the best in full-stack AWS technologies. We build critical systems to compute royalties, disburse payments and provide analytical reporting to digital content partners, worldwide. Our team develops systems that simplify and automate complex royalty payment and accounting rules, allowing us to eliminate financial risk and focus on delighting our customers. We strive to hold a high bar in paying our content partners accurately, completely and on-time. - 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience - 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience - 1+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience - 1+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience - 1+ years of Object Oriented Design experience - Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field - Experience programming with at least one software programming language - 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience - Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. Los Angeles County applicants: Job duties for this position include: work safely and cooperatively with other employees, supervisors, and staff; adhere to standards of excellence despite stressful conditions; communicate effectively and respectfully with employees, supervisors, and staff to ensure exceptional customer service; and follow all federal, state, and local laws and Company policies. Criminal history may have a direct, adverse, and negative relationship with some of the material job duties of this position. These include the duties and responsibilities listed above, as well as the abilities to adhere to company policies, exercise sound judgment, effectively manage stress and work safely and respectfully with others, exhibit trustworthiness and professionalism, and safeguard business operations and the Company’s reputation. Pursuant to the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner. The base salary range for this position is listed below. Your Amazon package will include sign-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs). Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Amazon also offers comprehensive benefits including health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription, Basic Life & AD&D insurance and option for Supplemental life plans, EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, Flexible Spending Accounts, Adoption and Surrogacy Reimbursement coverage), 401(k) matching, paid time off, and parental leave. Learn more about our benefits at https://amazon.jobs/en/benefits . USA, CA, San Francisco - 165,200.00 - 223,600.00 USD annually

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: Overview Customer Experience & AI (CEAI) is focused on delivering reliable, intelligent, and scalable experiences that help Microsoft support customers when they need us most. The organization brings together engineering, data, AI, and operational excellence to improve customer support outcomes, strengthen service resilience, and enable teams across Microsoft to deliver high-quality customer and business impact. We are seeking for a Software Engineer to join a team building modern full-stack software solutions that support critical customer and business workflows and help integrate, operate, and continuously improve the Customer Support Dialtone/Resiliency capability. This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys working across front-end experiences, back-end services, APIs, data, integrations, cloud platforms, and operational readiness. In this role, you will design and deliver maintainable software, including the initial build-out of a resilient support-continuity solution. You will also help ensure the capability remains ready through ongoing engineering maintenance, service operations, and cross-Microsoft business continuity and disaster recovery drills. You will collaborate across disciplines and contribute to reliable engineering systems that scale. Responsibilities Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain full-stack software solutions across user interfaces, APIs, services, data stores, and integrations Translate product and business requirements into reliable, scalable, secure, and maintainable technical designs and implementation plans Build high-quality code using modern engineering practices, including automated testing, code reviews, source control, CI/CD, observability, and secure development Partner with product managers, designers, engineers, operations teams, and stakeholders to deliver end-to-end customer and business value Troubleshoot defects, investigate service issues, perform root-cause analysis, and implement improvements that increase reliability, performance, and supportability Contribute to architecture discussions, technical documentation, operational readiness, and continuous improvement of engineering standards and development processes Learn and apply new technologies, frameworks, and platform capabilities to improve engineering outcomes and accelerate delivery Qualifications Required Qualifications: Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 2+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, or similar languages; OR equivalent experience. Other Requirements Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings: Microsoft Cloud Background Check. This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter. Preferred Qualifications: Master's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 3+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, or Python OR Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 5+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, or Python OR equivalent experience. Experience designing, building, testing, and maintaining full-stack applications and services across front-end, APIs, back-end systems, databases, cloud platforms, and integrations Collaboration, communication, problem-solving, and learning agility in ambiguous, cross-functional engineering environments experience. Experience with software engineering fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, object-oriented design, debugging, testing, source control, and service architecture. Experience with Azure, distributed systems, service reliability, security, performance optimization, telemetry, monitoring, CI/CD, and DevOps practices. Experience with AI-assisted development, copilots, machine learning services, prompt engineering, responsible AI, and demonstrated collaboration and problem-solving in cross-functional environments. Software Engineering IC3 - The typical base pay range for this role across the U.S. is USD $102,100 - $202,200 per year. There is a different range applicable to specific work locations, within the San Francisco Bay area and New York City metropolitan area, and the base pay range for this role in those locations is USD $133,800 - $219,200 per year. jobs.description: Overview Microsoft is a company where passionate innovators come to collaborate, envision what can be and take their careers further. This is a world of more possibilities, more innovation, more openness, and the sky is the limit thinking in a cloud-enabled world. Microsoft’s Azure Data engineering team is leading the transformation of analytics in the world of data with products like databases, data integration, big data analytics, messaging & real-time analytics, and business intelligence. The products our portfolio include Microsoft Fabric, Azure SQL DB, Azure Cosmos DB, Azure PostgreSQL, Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure Service Bus, Azure Event Grid, and Power BI. Our mission is to build the data platform for the age of AI, powering a new class of data-first applications and driving a data culture. ​​The Databases organization delivers trusted, scalable operational AI ready databases that power application development across cloud, hybrid, and on premises environments. Our portfolio includes SQL, Azure Cosmos DB, DocumentDB, PostgreSQL, and MySQL, supporting developers as they build AI native applications and run critical workloads at global scale.​ ​​​​We are hiring a Software Development Engineer to join the Azure PostgreSQL team, where you will work on and drive innovations in one or more areas of a relational database engine such as query processing, transaction logging and recovery, versioning, IO subsystems, scale-out and Distributed systems. You will have the opportunity to contribute to open-source PostgreSQL and Linux, and\or develop extensions. The group fosters a diverse and inclusive work culture that prioritizes people at all times. We spend our days collaborating with, teaching, and learning from a diverse set of talented engineers. We develop, test, and check code in every day. We do not just value differences or different perspectives. We seek them out and invite them in so we can tap into the collective power of everyone in the company. As a result, our customers are better served. Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond. Escalates issues to appropriate owners. Embody our culture and values .
